Summary: US-01 Submit a road or drainage report
Description:
As a resident, I want to submit a road or drainage report so I can receive proof that it was received.
Trace: PP1 → FR-01 → T01
Given a signed-in resident enters valid details
When they submit
Then one Received report is saved and its reference appears.

Summary: US-02 Assign a report with a due date
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to assign a report with a due date so I can make ownership clear.
Trace: PP2 → FR-02 → T02
Given an unassigned Received report exists
When the supervisor selects an officer and future deadline
Then the officer sees it in their queue and the report becomes Assigned.

As a resident, I want to check my report so I can see its progress without calling.
Trace: PP3 → FR-03 → T03
Given a resident owns an assigned report
When they open its reference
Then they see its current status and public history.

Summary: US-04 Start work on my case
Description:
As a assigned officer, I want to start work on my case so I can show that action is underway.
Trace: PP2 → FR-04 → T04
Given a report is assigned to the officer
When they mark it In progress
Then the new status and timestamp appear in its history.

Summary: US-05 See overdue cases in one queue
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to see overdue cases in one queue so I can follow up before they are forgotten.
Trace: PP4 → FR-05 → T05
Given an open assigned report has passed its deadline
When the overdue check runs twice
Then exactly one escalation is recorded and visible to the supervisor.

Summary: US-06 Close a case with an action summary
Description:
As a assigned officer, I want to close a case with an action summary so I can explain the outcome to the resident.
Trace: PP5 → FR-06 → T06
Given an In progress report belongs to the officer
When they save a nonblank action summary and resolve it
Then the report becomes Resolved and the resident can read the summary.

Summary: US-07 Filter the officer queue by category and status
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to filter the officer queue by category and status so I can find cases for follow-up.
Trace: PP2 → FR-07 → T07
Given the queue contains mixed categories and statuses
When the supervisor applies both filters
Then only matching reports are shown.

Summary: US-08 Export a weekly closure summary
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to export a weekly closure summary so I can review the pilot’s workload.
Trace: PP5 → FR-08 → T08
Given resolved cases exist within and outside the selected week
When the supervisor exports that week
Then the CSV contains only counts by category for that week.
